change: Opt-in clock anchors and client GC/event-loop observations, separate/drained server logs, test-only structured tokenizer GC, offline request/pause correlation and tail extrema.
findings: V2 has eight >500ms TTFT requests in every 1024-request phase. Maximum TTFT is 578.894-603.620ms, while p99 is 58.031-88.592ms. The affected fraction is below 1%; aggregate p99 did not expose the stall.
V3 observes tokenizer generation-two GC spans of 500.057, 487.729 and 492.640ms. Each span is fully inside TTFT for requests 168-175 in its phase, including both capture-off phases and the 10% phase.
The test-only tokenizer entrypoint changes import/allocation history: its affected indices differ from v2. No GC collection policy is changed and no controlled policy intervention is measured.

An intermediate v1 off phase observes 103.524ms client event-loop lag overlapping requests 88-95 without a simultaneous >=20ms client GC event. Timer lag identifies a late callback, not the delaying operation.
The original uninstrumented metadata-comparison spike cannot be retroactively assigned to these observed events.
limitations: Single resident H100, Qwen3-0.6B BF16, synthetic token IDs, local TCP Store, HTTP test Catalog and GPFS publication journal.
Diagnostics allocate event records, schedule timers, log GC and alter import history; timings are not a clean comparison to earlier uninstrumented sources.
Two clock anchors bound observed endpoint offset change, not every possible intervening wall-clock jump. Server mapping is omitted if the observed bound exceeds 5ms.
GC and event-loop intervals may overlap; their request overlaps are temporal associations and cannot be summed as causal latency.
Non-GC tokenizer work, detokenizer pauses and OS scheduling are not directly observed. The visible cgroup has no observed quota throttle; parent/host effects are not ruled out.
V1 shares server log sinks and lacks explicit log-drain waiting, so it is intermediate evidence. V2 adds complete separate logs; v3 adds tokenizer instrumentation. The disabled smoke uses v2.
Production GC policy, capture defaults and native streaming behavior remain unchanged. Production SLO, Catalog retention, SpecForge integration and trained draft quality are not proven.

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from sglang.test.training_capture_benchmark_client import summarize_requests
from sglang.test.training_capture_diagnostics import correlate_pauses, scheduler_gc_events

lab = Path("/gpfs/users/fuxuanwei-1/dspark-maas-lab")
counts = {"phases": 0, "requests": 0, "snapshots": 0, "diagnostic_phases": 0}
reports = []
for name in ("latency-diagnostics-v1", "latency-diagnostics-v2", "latency-diagnostics-disabled-v2"):
    report_path = lab / "experiments" / name / "report.json"
    report = json.loads(report_path.read_text())
    assert report["status"] == "completed"
    phase_count = 0
    for run in report["rounds"]:
        for phase in run["phases"]:
            details = phase["request_details"]
            raw = Path(details["path"]).read_bytes()
            assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == details["sha256"]
            saved = json.loads(raw)
            assert saved["status"] == "completed"
            ids = set(details["published_trace_ids"])
            assert len(ids) == len(details["published_trace_ids"]) == phase["readback"].get("validated_samples", 0)
            replay = summarize_requests(saved["requests"], ids, count=report["config"]["num_prompts"], output_len=32)
            assert replay == {key: details[key] for key in replay}
            if report["config"]["latency_diagnostics"]:
                diag = phase["latency_diagnostics"]
                if "server_logs" in diag:
                    for artifact in diag["server_logs"].values():
                        assert hashlib.sha256(Path(artifact["path"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == artifact["sha256"]
                    log_path = diag["server_logs"]["stderr"]["path"]
                else:
                    log_path = diag["server_log"]
                    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(log_path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == diag["server_log_sha256"]
                gc_events = scheduler_gc_events(Path(log_path).read_text())
                assert gc_events == diag["scheduler_gc"]
                assert gc_events["unmatched_starts"] == gc_events["unmatched_ends"] == 0
                replay = correlate_pauses(saved["requests"], saved["diagnostics"], gc_events, ids)
                assert replay == {key: diag[key] for key in replay}
                assert saved["diagnostics"]["dropped_events"] == saved["diagnostics"]["incomplete_gc"] == 0
                counts["diagnostic_phases"] += 1
            else:
                assert "diagnostics" not in saved and "latency_diagnostics" not in phase
            counts["requests"] += len(saved["requests"])
            counts["snapshots"] += len(ids)
            counts["phases"] += 1
            phase_count += 1
    reports.append({"path": str(report_path), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(report_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "phases": phase_count})
print(json.dumps({"status": "passed", "counts": counts, "reports": reports, "request_summaries_reproduced": True, "pause_correlations_reproduced": True, "artifact_hashes_verified": True, "inference_requests": 0}))
